jobs.description: 한국산업단지공단 전국등록공장현황 from data.go.kr (root ADR-0280 §4; scripts/ops/registered-factory-cycle.sh): ask the portal once which file is current and, only when it is not the last one landed, land the zip in Bronze, check its member against the source contract (name, CP949, header, row bounds), give each row the PNU its address resolves to (jibun address through the 법정동 code table and silver.parcel_boundaries, else road address through silver.building_register_titles) and append the edition to silver.registered_factory with its match rate (load-registered-factory-silver: DuckDB inside the publisher and its own Iceberg append, root ADR-0559; no Spark). `unchanged` without a load on the days the file is the same (the provider publishes about once a year).
jobs.memory_measured: 13M on the days the file is the same (journal `memory peak` 2026-10-18..11-08, 13 runs). Since root ADR-0559 the Silver load is the publisher's DuckDB inside this unit (it was the spark container, 8g driver): sized as the onbid Silver load, the same stage (2.1G measured 2026-11-20 on 48 objects); an edition (220,000 rows, yearly) has not run under this cap yet; systemd logs the peak of every run under this cap

expected_outcome.basis: the factory register file is released yearly (expected_cadence yearly, 10,200 h) plus one daily turn.

assets.title: 전국 등록공장
assets.description: 등록공장 파일의 판마다 행 전부를 쌓고, 주소로 찾은 PNU 와 그 단계(지번 주소·도로명 주소), 못 찾은 이유를 남긴다(루트 ADR-0280 §4). 필지 by-PNU 종류 parcel-factories 가 가장 새 판을 읽는다(루트 ADR-0449).

dependencies.description: 새 판(포털이 알리는 파일 id 가 바뀌었을 때)만 Bronze 에 받고, 주소로 PNU 를 찾아(지번 → 도로명) 판 전체를 쌓는다.
